pages.md:
# Welcome

This vault uses the Karpathy LLM-wiki method.

## Three operations

- **Ingest** — paste a URL or text. The LLM reads it, creates a Source page, drafts updates to related pages, and appends to [[log]].
- **Query** — ask a question. The LLM reads relevant pages and answers with citations. Save useful answers as synthesis pages.
- **Lint** — periodic audit for orphans, broken links, missing tags.

## Anchor pages

- [[index]] — auto-generated catalog of all pages
- [[log]] — append-only ingest and query history

## Try

1. Click **⊕ Ingest** in the top bar. Paste any text. See drafts appear.
2. Click **? Query**. Ask "what is in this vault?".
3. Open [[Karpathy LLM Wiki]] to see the method.

pages.title: Karpathy LLM Wiki
pages.md:
# Karpathy LLM Wiki

## Summary

A second-brain pattern where the wiki is a directory of LLM-generated markdown files. Knowledge is compiled once and kept current.

## Three layers

- **Raw sources** — immutable input (articles, PDFs, transcripts)
- **Wiki** — markdown files: entity, concept, source, synthesis pages
- **Schema** — config that drives the LLM (this vault uses frontmatter + an internal prompt)

## Three operations

- **Ingest** — read source, update 10–15 pages with summaries and cross-references
- **Query** — answer questions with citations
- **Lint** — audit for contradictions, orphans, gaps

## Two anchors

- [[index]] — catalog
- [[log]] — chronological record

## Why flat

Folders force premature classification. Tags + wikilinks let the graph emerge.

# 2026-04-23 D_studioproject — GPT Image 2 × Seedance 2.0 workflow

## Summary

Practical AI-ad workflow using GPT Image 2, Higgsfield, and Seedance 2.0 to animate a landing-page style commercial while keeping UI text fixed and readable.

## Source

<https://x.com/D_studioproject/status/2047212829430960501>

## Body

Thread workflow:

Step 1: Create a base image.
Step 2: Inject the base image into GPT Image 2 via Higgsfield with a landing-page prompt, using high quality and 4K so embedded text stays sharp.
Step 3: Upload the resulting image to Seedance 2.0, set resolution to 1080p, and animate it with a prompt that keeps UI elements static and readable while the subject and product move inside the frame.

The worked example is a kimchi product commercial with nearly locked camera motion, slow product rotation, premium highlights, and static on-screen UI. The post also includes a generalized prompt template for camera, background, product position, lighting, and persistent UI layout.

pages.title: GPT Image 2 + Seedance static-UI commercial workflow
pages.md:
# GPT Image 2 + Seedance static-UI commercial workflow

## Summary

A practical workflow for turning a still landing-page composition into a motion commercial while keeping all interface text static, visible, and readable.

## Workflow

1. Generate a base still image for the product/scene.
2. Use GPT Image 2 through Higgsfield to restyle the composition while preserving the page layout and color treatment.
3. Send the image to Seedance 2.0 at 1080p so text remains sharp.
4. Animate only the in-frame subject/product motion while keeping the UI container fixed.

## Key idea

The design acts as a static container and the motion lives inside it. This lets a landing-page or ad mockup become a cinematic short without sacrificing text readability.

## Prompting notes

- Keep camera movement minimal or locked.
- Specify product rotation, highlight behavior, and ambient detail explicitly.
- Call out that logos, nav bars, CTA buttons, hero text, badges, and product cards must remain static and legible through the whole shot.

## Source

- [[2026-04-23 D_studioproject — GPT Image 2 × Seedance 2.0 workflow]]
